facts.summary: Phase 3 trial missed primary endpoint; ganaxolone development discontinued, strategic alternatives explored · Phase 3 · ganaxolone in TSC seizures · approved for CDKL5 only
facts.indication: seizures associated with tuberous sclerosis complex

evidence.summary: the Phase 3 TrustTSC trial evaluating oral ganaxolone for the treatment of seizures associated with tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC) in children and adults did not meet the primary endpoint
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The trial did not achieve statistical significance on its primary endpoint of percent reduction in 28-day frequency of TSC-associated seizures
evidence.safety: Ganaxolone was generally well-tolerated with a safety profile consistent with previous clinical trials.
evidence.program_discontinued: Marinus is discontinuing further ganaxolone clinical development and is taking additional steps to reduce costs, including a reduction in its workforce.
